Buildings are grouped closely along a grid of streets in the
lower left: a nucleated cluster within this frame.
The cluster lies beside the tarred main road, where the town
street joins it; farther back, beyond the belt of trees, the main
Open bush surrounds the cluster, with a smaller group of
The settlement continues past the left edge, so this is part of
one place, not the pattern of a whole region.
